scope: S24 RDC root-cause hardening and Android build memory guard

root_cause.primary: Android system LOW_MEMORY pressure killed com.termux and ai.openclaw.app.
root_cause.evidence: ApplicationExitInfo recorded com.termux LOW_MEMORY at 18:10:38.640 after a broad LOW_MEMORY kill wave.
root_cause.contributing_factor: A payment-native Gradle single-use daemon was running with -Xmx1536m immediately before the kill wave; Android does not attribute the global pressure to one process, so this remains a contributing factor rather than a uniquely proven cause.

changes: Reintegrate the previously validated claw-live in-process log follower and phantom-process documentation into the private runtime branch.
Install a Gradle user guard limiting Android builds to 768 MiB heap, two active processors, one worker, no parallel execution and no persistent daemon.
Expose the build guard in doctor.sh and keep rollback as removal of the managed Gradle block.
boundaries: The Android phantom-process monitor remains enabled; max_phantom_processes remains 128.
The build guard preserves unrelated Gradle user properties and refuses conflicting managed keys outside its own block.
No new daemon, scheduler or memory store is introduced.
rollback: Run android-build-guard.py --remove and promote the previous verified Tier0 release if runtime rollback is required.
